package clickhouse

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
	pkglog "github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/pkg/log"
)

type BufferedEventSink struct {
	repo          domain.EventRepository
	batchSize     int
	flushInterval time.Duration
	ch            chan domain.Event
	logger        pkglog.Logger

	ctx    context.Context
	cancel context.CancelFunc
	wg     sync.WaitGroup
}

func NewBufferedEventSink(repo domain.EventRepository, batchSize int, flushInterval time.Duration, bufferSize int, logger pkglog.Logger) *BufferedEventSink {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	s := &BufferedEventSink{
		repo:          repo,
		batchSize:     batchSize,
		flushInterval: flushInterval,
		ch:            make(chan domain.Event, bufferSize),
		logger:        logger,
		ctx:           ctx,
		cancel:        cancel,
	}
	s.wg.Add(1)
	go s.run()
	return s
}

func (s *BufferedEventSink) Publish(ctx context.Context, ev domain.Event) error {
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	case <-s.ctx.Done():
		return context.Canceled
	case s.ch <- ev:
		return nil
	}
}

func (s *BufferedEventSink) Close() {
	s.cancel()
	s.wg.Wait()
}

func (s *BufferedEventSink) run() {
	defer s.wg.Done()

	var batch []domain.Event
	ticker := time.NewTicker(s.flushInterval)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	flush := func() {
		if len(batch) == 0 {
			return
		}
		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(context.Background(), batch); err != nil {
			s.logger.Error().Err(err).Msg("failed to flush events to clickhouse")
		}
		batch = batch[:0]
	}

	for {
		select {
		case <-s.ctx.Done():
			// drain the channel before exiting
			for {
				select {
				case ev := <-s.ch:
					batch = append(batch, ev)
				default:
					flush()
					return
				}
			}
		case ev := <-s.ch:
			batch = append(batch, ev)
			if len(batch) >= s.batchSize {
				flush()
			}
		case <-ticker.C:
			flush()
		}
	}
}
